label: No-limit Hold'em, 6-max
description: The questions a 6-max no-limit Hold'em player asks most often. Values are engine vocabulary; the Research Browser shows them in poker language.

presets.name: Open raise (RFI) by position
presets.description: How often each seat raises first in when nobody has entered the pot yet.

presets.name: Voluntarily put money in, by position (VPIP)
presets.description: Of the hands each seat played preflop, how many it put money into voluntarily: a call or a raise, never a forced blind. The denominator is hands, not decisions, so calling a raise after limping is one entry.

presets.name: Raise preflop, by position (PFR)
presets.description: Of the hands each seat played preflop, how many it raised in, whether opening or raising over someone.

presets.name: 3-bet by position
presets.description: How often each seat re-raises when it is facing a single open raise. The denominator is that opportunity, not the 3-bets themselves.

presets.name: Fold / call / 4-bet when facing a 3-bet
presets.description: How the original raiser responds to a 3-bet: how often they fold, call or come back over the top.

presets.name: BB defence versus a BTN open
presets.description: What the big blind does when the button opens: folds, calls or 3-bets.

presets.name: SB defence versus a BTN open
presets.description: What the small blind does when the button opens. The small blind also has the big blind behind, so their 3-bet rate usually reads higher.

presets.name: Squeeze opportunities taken, by position
presets.description: How often a player squeezes when a raise has been called behind it.

presets.name: 4-bet by position
presets.description: How often each seat re-raises when it is facing a 3-bet.

presets.name: Open raise size, by position
presets.description: The average opening size, in basis points of the pot (100 bp is 1% of the pot).

presets.name: 3-bet size, by position
presets.description: The average 3-bet size, in basis points of the pot.

presets.name: Flop c-bet frequency in single-raised pots
presets.description: How often the raiser follows up with a bet on the flop.

presets.name: Flop c-bet, by position
presets.description: Flop continuation bet frequency from each seat.

presets.name: Flop c-bets by bet size
presets.description: How many flop c-bets fall in each configured sizing bucket: the shape of the sizing distribution, counted over the c-bets themselves.

presets.name: Fold versus a flop c-bet, by bet size
presets.description: How often the defender folds, split by how big the c-bet was. The sample is the number of decisions, not the number of folds.

presets.name: Fold / call / raise versus a flop c-bet
presets.description: The full defensive response to a flop c-bet, by the seat that faced it.

presets.name: Delayed c-bet, by position
presets.description: How often the preflop raiser checks the flop and bets the turn instead: the delayed c-bet, measured against every turn where they had the lead.

presets.name: Probe bet, by position
presets.description: How often a player bets the turn after the flop aggressor checked behind, out of every turn where they had that chance.

presets.name: Turn barrel after the flop c-bet
presets.description: How often the preflop raiser bets the turn as well as the flop.

presets.name: River barrel after the turn bet
presets.description: How often the preflop raiser fires the third barrel on the river.

presets.name: River overbet frequency
presets.description: How often a river bet is 125% of the pot or more, out of every river decision in the population. The size is part of the numerator, so a smaller bet stays in the denominator.

presets.name: Flop raise facing a bet
presets.description: How often a flop decision that faces a bet answers it with a raise. Check-raises dominate it; a raise over a donk bet is the same action and is counted too.

presets.name: Flop c-bet in 3-bet pots, in and out of position
presets.description: How often the 3-bettor continues on the flop, split by whether they have position.

presets.name: Facing a flop c-bet in a 3-bet pot
presets.description: How the caller in a 3-bet pot answers the flop c-bet.

presets.name: Flop aggression in 4-bet pots
presets.description: How often the 4-bettor leads the flop, out of the flops where they had the lead and no bet in front.

presets.name: First bet in a limped pot
presets.description: How often somebody bets the flop when nobody raised preflop, out of the flop decisions with no bet in front. Checked flops stay in the denominator.

presets.name: Flop c-bet by board suit structure
presets.description: How board suit structure changes the flop c-bet rate: rainbow, two-tone or monotone.

presets.name: Flop c-bet by board pairing
presets.description: How the c-bet rate changes on paired flops.

presets.name: Flop c-bet by board connectivity
presets.description: How connected, semi-connected and disconnected flops change the c-bet rate.

presets.name: Fold versus a turn bet when an overcard falls
presets.description: How often the defender folds the turn when the runout is an overcard, by seat. Compare it with the same question without the runout filter.

presets.name: Hero's opening range
presets.description: The 13x13 grid of the hands hero actually opens with. Cells with unknown cards are kept apart rather than folded into a class.

presets.name: Hero's 3-bet range
presets.description: The 13x13 grid of the hands hero 3-bets with.

presets.name: Known cards facing a flop c-bet
presets.description: The range defenders actually hold when they face a flop c-bet, over the hands that were shown.

presets.name: Made-hand distribution when facing a flop bet
presets.description: What players hold when they face a flop bet: air, pairs, sets and better. Decisions with unknown cards are reported separately.

presets.name: Flush-draw share facing a flop c-bet
presets.description: Of the classified decisions facing a flop c-bet, how many faced it with a flush draw. The denominator is every classified decision, so the share means what it says.

presets.name: Hand strength by street
presets.description: How nutted players are on each street, over the decisions whose cards were known.

presets.name: Population: open raise by position
presets.description: How the opponents as a group open, by seat: the pool's baseline, not hero's own game.

presets.name: Population: 3-bet by position
presets.description: The pool's 3-bet frequency by seat, over every seat that faced a single open raise.

presets.name: Population: fold versus a 3-bet
presets.description: How often the pool folds to a 3-bet, by the seat that opened.

presets.name: Population: c-bet by street
presets.description: How the pool keeps barrelling, flop to river, in single-raised pots: the share of lead-flops, lead-turns and lead-rivers it bets.

presets.name: Population: c-bet size distribution
presets.description: Which sizes the pool uses for continuation bets, in the configured buckets.

presets.name: Population: river bet size distribution
presets.description: How the pool sizes river bets, and how often the river is an overbet.

presets.name: Realized profit by position
presets.description: Hero's realized profit per seat. This is money actually won, not an EV-adjusted figure.

presets.name: Realized profit facing a c-bet, by response
presets.description: What folding, calling and raising against a c-bet actually returned. Conditional hand profit, not immediate action EV.

presets.name: EV-adjusted result by position (all-in EV)
presets.description: Hero's all-in EV-adjusted result per seat. Reported separately from realized profit, never added to it.

presets.name: Realized profit per decision, by pot type
presets.description: Which pot shapes pay hero, per decision rather than per hand.
